assets.app/test_server.py:
import json, threading, urllib.request
from http.server import HTTPServer
import server

def test_bookings():
    httpd = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), server.Handler)
    threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    base = 'http://127.0.0.1:%d' % httpd.server_address[1]
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + '/api/bookings', data=json.dumps({'name': 'Ada'}).encode(), method='POST')
    assert urllib.request.urlopen(req).status == 201
    assert json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base + '/api/bookings'))[0]['name'] == 'Ada'
    httpd.shutdown()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_bookings()
    print('1 passed')
